what: T12 knob calibration, FIT HALF ONLY (run with --half fit, once per task: GSM8K on GPU 0, MBPP on GPU 1): tokens/step of each adaptive decoder over a bracketing knob range, zero-shot chat, gen 256, block 32, greedy, fp16, Jarvis 2x RTX PRO 6000. Speed of a configuration = 256*N / sum(n_forward) over its N problems (aggregate, not the mean of per-problem ratios). topk_conf k=4 is the timing anchor (exactly 4 tokens/step, 64 forward passes). scripts/pick_knobs.py interpolates log(tokens/step) to the 2 / 4 / 8 targets per task and writes prereg/t12_grid_<task>.json. Knobs are chosen by speed only, never by fit-half accuracy. Extended 2026-10-27 after the first Jarvis calibration (375b079, run 19739f16) did not bracket 8 tokens/step (fastest MBPP: threshold 6.74, c3a 6.84, entropy_bounded 5.00; GSM8K entropy_bounded 6.45): added threshold tau 0.2/0.1, entropy_bounded gamma 10/30/100, c3a alpha 0.75/0.9, chosen from those fit-half speeds only.
